In short

Mirc Glow Avocado Night Cream is a 30 g Korean-inspired face cream made in Karnataka, India, with avocado, aloe vera, vitamin b3 (niacinamide) and kojic acid. It costs ₹649 (MRP ₹949), about ₹21.6 per gram. Best for: dry or tight-feeling skin; the best value per gram.

  • Use: Evening, as the last step
  • Skin type: Dry and normal skin
  • A jar lasts: about 4 to 6 weeks at a pea-sized amount each night
  • Free shipping, Cash on Delivery, 7-day returns on sealed jars

Mirc Glow Avocado Night Cream is a rich, nourishing avocado night cream made with avocado, aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid. It is the last step of your evening: you cleanse, you apply a small amount, and you let it work while you sleep. By morning, skin feels soft and comfortable instead of tight.

Its Korean-inspired approach is simple. There is no ten-step routine to learn. A pea-sized amount after cleansing is enough, and the texture sinks in within a few minutes, so it does not end up on your pillow.

Why choose this avocado night cream?

Most night creams are either too light to help dry skin or so heavy that they feel greasy. This one sits in between. Avocado gives it a cushioned, comforting feel, and aloe vera keeps it fresh, so skin feels hydrated without a sticky finish.

It also does more than moisturise. Vitamin B3 and kojic acid are included to support a smoother, more even-looking complexion with regular use. You get nourishment and tone care in a single jar, which keeps your evening short.

It is not a replacement for a full routine. It is the step that finishes one, and it works well alongside the cleanser and sunscreen you already use.

Nighttime benefits

  • Helps skin feel nourished and hydrated through the night.
  • Leaves skin feeling soft, smooth and comfortable by morning.
  • Supports a radiant, even-looking appearance over time.
  • Eases the tight, dry feeling that follows cleansing.
  • Gives you a calm, simple last step for your evening ritual.

Key ingredients in this avocado night cream

The listed key ingredients are avocado, aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid. Here is what each one brings.

Avocado

The avocado fruit is naturally rich in oil. Avocado oil is high in oleic acid, which is why it feels so soft on the skin. In this cream it provides the comforting, cushioned layer that dry skin needs.

Aloe vera

Aloe vera is widely used in skincare for its light, fresh feel. It balances the richness of avocado so the cream does not sit heavily on your face.

Vitamin B3

Also called niacinamide, vitamin B3 is one of the most popular ingredients in Korean skincare for a smooth, refined-looking surface. It is gentle and suits most skin types.

Kojic acid

Kojic acid is used in cosmetics made for a brighter, more even-looking tone. Because of it, daily sunscreen is important while you use this cream.

For the most accurate and current ingredient list, please refer to the product packaging. You can also read plain-English explanations in our skincare ingredient glossary.

Who is it for?

Dry skin. This is the skin type that enjoys it most. Use a full pea-sized amount, and go back over dry patches with a second thin layer.

Normal and combination skin. Apply a little more on the cheeks and less on the forehead and nose.

Oily skin. You can still use it. Take half the usual amount and keep it for the evening. More tips are in our guide to night cream for oily skin.

Sensitive skin. Patch test first, and begin with every second night.

The cream is suitable for both women and men.

How to use

  1. Cleanse your face and pat it dry, leaving the skin slightly damp.
  2. Take a pea-sized amount and warm it between your fingertips.
  3. Press it gently over your face and neck, avoiding the eye area.
  4. Use it as the final moisturising step of your evening routine.
  5. In the morning, finish your routine with sunscreen.

If kojic acid is new to your skin, start with every second night for two weeks and then move to nightly use. As with any cosmetic product, patch test before first use and stop if irritation occurs. Our step-by-step guide shows how to apply night cream properly.

Where it fits in a Korean-inspired routine

Korean routines move from the thinnest texture to the thickest, and the cream always comes last.

  1. Cleanse, twice if you wore sunscreen or make-up.
  2. Pat in a hydrating toner.
  3. Apply a serum, if you use one.
  4. Seal everything in with this avocado night cream.

On a tired evening, steps one and four are enough. To get a full morning and night plan for your skin type, try the skincare routine builder.

What to expect

The first night. Skin feels softer and less tight the next morning.

After one week. Dry, flaky patches begin to settle, and skin looks more hydrated.

After four to eight weeks. With nightly use and daily sunscreen, skin tone looks smoother and more even.

Everyone's skin is different, so your results may come sooner or later than this. What matters most is using it consistently.

Using it through the seasons

In winter, when the air is dry, use the full amount every night and include your neck. In summer and during the monsoon, a thinner layer is enough. If you sleep in an air-conditioned room, keep using it all year, because cooled air dries the skin overnight.

Good to know before you start

  • Wear a broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning.
  • Add only one new product at a time, so you know how your skin responds.
  • Avoid using it on broken or irritated skin.
  • Close the jar tightly and store it away from heat and direct sunlight.
  • Check the use-before date printed on the pack.

It is a cosmetic product and is not intended to treat any skin condition. You can read what to watch for in avocado night cream side effects.

Avocado Night Cream FAQs

What is this avocado night cream designed to do?

It is designed to help skin feel nourished, hydrated and comfortable while supporting a smooth, radiant-looking finish.

When should I use it?

Apply it in the evening to clean skin as the final moisturising step in your routine.

What key ingredients are listed?

The listed key ingredients are avocado, aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid.

Can I use this avocado night cream every night?

Yes, once your skin is comfortable with it. Begin with every second night if kojic acid is new to you.

Is it suitable for oily skin?

Yes, in a thin layer. Use half a pea-sized amount and apply it mainly to the cheeks.

Can men use it?

Yes. It is suitable for both women and men.

How long does one jar last?

With a pea-sized amount each night, a jar typically lasts around four to six weeks.

Is this a Korean skincare product?

It is a Korean-inspired skincare cream. It follows the Korean approach to texture and ingredients and can be used as part of a simple evening routine.

हिंदी में पढ़ें: एवोकाडो नाइट क्रीम के फायदे. For mornings, see the avocado day cream guide.

What is the best avocado night cream for dry skin in India?

For dry or tight-feeling skin, choose a rich avocado night cream with a humectant and a soothing ingredient. Our Avocado Night Cream (30 g, ₹649) is our richest avocado cream, with aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid, and the best value per gram in our range.

What is the difference between avocado night cream and avocado day cream?

A night cream is richer and stays on while you sleep. A day cream is lighter and goes under sunscreen. Read avocado day cream for the morning version.

Does avocado night cream make skin fair?

No. It moisturises skin so it looks softer and fresher, and kojic acid and vitamin B3 help it look more even over 8 to 12 weeks with daily sunscreen. It does not change natural skin colour.

Can I buy avocado night cream in 1 kg?

Yes. Salons and resellers can order it by the kilo; see avocado cream in kg.
